chip.description: Fixed-function collision/hitbox math coprocessor: takes object centre and half-extent parameters and returns a boolean overlap result, with no access to graphics data.
chip.notes: src/mame/konami/k054000.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Konami K054000 hitbox/math custom chip ... It is passed a few parameters, and returns a boolean telling if collision happened. It has no access to gfx data, it only does arithmetical operations on the parameters"); konamiic.txt annotates it "(collision)". Filed dsp on taxonomy §4.3's "a documented math engine is dsp even when it is a board-specific part"; MAME's device full name says "Protection", but TB6 reserves protection for parts designed to enforce security and the documented behaviour is arithmetic. Flagged as a judgement call.
